heading: Why Work With Me?
subheading: You've got options. Here's why clients choose to work with me.

items.title: Built for Results
items.description: Every project starts with one question: what measurable outcome do you need? I build towards that, not feature lists.

items.title: Weeks, Not Months
items.description: Your first working prototype arrives in days. Full projects launch in 2-4 weeks. I move fast because your time matters.

items.title: Transparent Process
items.description: No surprise invoices. No scope creep fees. You know exactly what you're paying before I write a single line of code.

items.title: Disciplined Execution
items.description: You're not getting random contractors. You get me, direct communication, clear milestones, and zero handoffs.

items.title: Product Thinking First
items.description: Your idea becomes a clear roadmap and consistent output. I think like a founder, not just a coder.

items.title: Consistent Progress
items.description: Weekly progress reports, transparent tracking, and direct communication. You always know exactly where your project stands.
